_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-of-35-window coil base rate makes HOLD the statistically honest default — the bullish asymmetry is real but the breaker has not fired, so patience preserves the edge until price confirms.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — Analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing coil punishment; Narrative implies directional turn is near. Judge sides with Analyst's HOLD on base-rate grounds while keeping LONG as the positioning signal to capture asymmetry.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $67,500 with funding below 0.015% and ETF flows remaining elevated above 80
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $62,000 with VIX spiking above 20 and exchange netflow flipping above 70
